meta.title: Collaborate with Product Beers
meta.description: Help the product community as a sponsor or by lending your space for meetups.

hero.label: Help out
hero.description: We're a bunch of friends who get together to talk about product. If your company wants to help out, here's how.

sponsor.title: Buy the beers
sponsor.description: Help keep meetups free. In return, your logo will be everywhere.

visibility.title: Your logo visible
visibility.description: On the website, social media and at every event. Hard to miss.

community.title: Reach 200+ people
community.description: PMs, designers, devs and founders. People who build product.

networking.title: Meet the crowd
networking.description: Come to the event, introduce your company, have a drink with everyone.

content.title: Give a talk
content.description: Share your expertise with the community in a talk or workshop.

hoster.title: Lend your space
hoster.description: Got an office with a meeting room? Let us use it for an event and we'll thank you publicly.

talent.title: Show off your company
talent.description: Product folks will see where you work and what the vibe is like.

brand.title: Good image
brand.description: Your company gets associated with the product community.

social.title: We mention you
social.description: In every post, story and event communication.

community.title: Join the event
community.description: Your team can stick around and participate like everyone else.

cta.title: Like the idea?
cta.description: Drop us a line and we'll chat. No strings attached.
